title: Filing by a fixed convention
why: The most common cheap task there is: a document gets a name according to a rule that is stated in full. No judgement required, only exact compliance. A model that cannot do this reliably is of no use for anything cheaper either. Note that this checks a string, not a file — see NOTES.md on Harbor for why that is the wrong shape for what it measures.
rubric: Date from the document, not from its arrival
prompt:
Name the file according to this convention and output ONLY the filename, with no explanation and no quotation marks.

Convention:
  YYYY-MM-DD_Sender_Subject_STATUS.pdf
  - YYYY-MM-DD is the date of the document, not the date it arrived
  - Sender: one word, as on the letterhead
  - Subject: one word, spaces become underscores
  - STATUS is SENT if the document has already gone out, otherwise DRAFT

Document:
  Letterhead: Waterworks
  Subject: AnnualStatement
  Date of the letter: 4 March 2026
  Received on: 11 March 2026
  Margin note: delivered by post on 4.3.
